title: BUGFIX — posting-auto-deliver.ts gate excludes auto-deliver entries
rationale: TICKET-016-DELIVER-01: manual-posts.jsonl has 160 entries, 157 of which have source=auto-deliver (records of what the script sent to Telegram). Gate check counts all 160 → 160>=30 → permanently skips. Fix: filter source=='auto-deliver' from gate count. Real manual posts = 3. 3<30 → auto-deliver resumes. Also: GATE_DATE=2026-04-07 is still future (12 days), so gate math should work correctly once count is fixed.
success_criteria: npx ts-node posting-auto-deliver.ts --dry-run (or simulation) no longer prints 'Gate target met' immediately

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/posting-auto-deliver.ts, find the gate check (around line 233-236). Change: const manualPosts = readJsonLines(MANUAL_POSTS_PATH); if (manualPosts.length >= GATE_TARGET) to: const manualPosts = readJsonLines(MANUAL_POSTS_PATH); const manualPostCount = manualPosts.filter((e: any) => e.source !== 'auto-deliver').length; if (manualPostCount >= GATE_TARGET). Update all subsequent references to manualPosts.length (gate math postsLeft calculation at ~line 241) to use manualPostCount instead. Keep change minimal.
